title: Small/Efficient LLM
description: Quantized or distilled language model optimized for edge devices and budget-constrained hosting.
name: Small/Efficient LLM
summary: Small/Efficient LLMs are compact language models (typically 1B to 3B parameters) created through knowledge distillation, architectural pruning, or post-training quantization, enabling execution on local CPU/mobile hardware.
use_when: Hosting models on-device (mobile/edge) or needing extremely low latency and host costs.
avoid_when: Solving complex multi-step logical reasoning or coding tasks requiring massive world knowledge.
pros: Extremely low latency and compute cost per token.
Can run completely offline on standard client hardware.
Very small file size, minimizing download and RAM overhead.
cons: Reduced logical reasoning and command following capacity.
Lower factual recall; prone to hallucinations without RAG wiring.
Limited context window sizes compared to foundation LLMs.

key_hyperparams.name: quantization_bits
key_hyperparams.note: Precision of model weights. 4-bit or 8-bit integer formats are standard for edge deployment.
